images.description: Before (PR #25395 head), light: the Apple failure toast sits on Sign in with Google; the Google button is not hit-testable while it shows. iPhone 17 Pro simulator, iOS 26.4, prod flavor debug build (local_prod profile), no Apple Account, so Sign in with Apple returns AuthorizationError 1000 for real.

After, light: the same toast floats 12 pt above Sign in with Apple; both buttons stay tappable. Same position on 3 repeated failures. iPhone 17 Pro simulator, iOS 26.4, prod flavor debug build (local_prod profile), no Apple Account, so Sign in with Apple returns AuthorizationError 1000 for real.

Before, dark appearance: the toast covers Sign in with Google. iPhone 17 Pro simulator, iOS 26.4, prod flavor debug build (local_prod profile), no Apple Account, so Sign in with Apple returns AuthorizationError 1000 for real.

After, dark appearance: the toast floats above both sign-in buttons. iPhone 17 Pro simulator, iOS 26.4, prod flavor debug build (local_prod profile), no Apple Account, so Sign in with Apple returns AuthorizationError 1000 for real.

Before, largest accessibility text (scrolled to the buttons): the 480 pt toast covers Sign in with Apple. The clipped button labels are a separate, pre-existing defect. iPhone 17 Pro simulator, iOS 26.4, prod flavor debug build (local_prod profile), no Apple Account, so Sign in with Apple returns AuthorizationError 1000 for real.

After, largest accessibility text: the toast ends above Sign in with Apple, which stays tappable. The clipped button labels are a separate, pre-existing defect. iPhone 17 Pro simulator, iOS 26.4, prod flavor debug build (local_prod profile), no Apple Account, so Sign in with Apple returns AuthorizationError 1000 for real.
